explanation.headline: Adenosine supply at three Corvale sites ranges from 18 to 21 days on hand; the HealthFirst label (NDC 51662145003) is linked to a U.S. relabeler last inspected VAI 2025-06-26, and the Gland Pharma label (NDC 68083015610) is linked to an India manufacturer last inspected VAI 2024-07-25; Eugia US LLC is not on FDA's shortage list today but its label names no plant we could place.

sentences.text: Corvale East holds 806 units at 45.5 per day for 18 days on hand, Corvale General holds 605 units at 31.8 per day for 19 days, and Corvale Lakeside holds 96 units at 4.5 per day for 21 days.
The HealthFirst label (NDC 51662145003) identifies HF Acquisition Co LLC as a U.S. relabeler with FEI 3014534, last inspected VAI on 2025-06-26.
The Gland Pharma label (NDC 68083015610) identifies Gland Pharma Limited as an India manufacturer with FEI 3002647489, last inspected VAI on 2024-07-25.

rejected.text: Eugia US LLC is not on FDA's shortage list today, but its label names no plant we could place.
Check current allocation and contract terms for the HealthFirst and Gland Pharma NDCs, verify Eugia US LLC sourcing and plant registration, and monitor FDA shortage list updates for any new postings.

Q-ddd706.sql: SELECT s.hospital, s.item_key, s.ndc11, s.ndc_as_recorded, s.description, s.on_hand, s.daily_use, s.unit, s.ndc_match, p.generic_name, p.labeler_name, p.package_ndc, p.spl_set_id, p.dosage_form, p.route FROM (SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_general UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_east UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_lakeside) s LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = s.ndc11 WHERE lower(coalesce(p.generic_name, '')) LIKE '%adenosine%' OR lower(s.description) LIKE '%adenosine%' ORDER BY s.hospital, s.item_key

Q-4e5345.sql: SELECT ps.set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, ps.est_operations, ps.site_source, st.fei, st.firm_name, st.country_iso3, st.address FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE ps.set_id IN ('996fc80e-b680-31f1-e053-2995a90aa0f1', 'fecdce1e-4233-f44c-e053-6294a90a714f', '1b701a86-3c4e-4c13-bf9e-aa9e73774c20') ORDER BY ps.set_id, ps.establishment

Q-3eb5fc.sql: SELECT generic_name, company_name, status, package_ndc, initial_posting_date, update_date, substr(related_info, 1, 220) AS related_info FROM fda.shortage_current WHERE lower(generic_name) LIKE '%adenosine%' ORDER BY status, company_name, package_ndc

Q-6cc68a.sql: SELECT generic, category, first_posting, first_seen, last_seen, resolved_first_seen, statuses, n_companies, reasons FROM fda.shortage_episodes WHERE lower(generic) LIKE '%adenosine%' ORDER BY first_posting

Q-b00a11.sql: SELECT p.ndc11, p.package_ndc, p.labeler_name, p.dosage_form, p.spl_set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, st.fei, st.country_iso3 FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps ON ps.set_id = p.spl_set_id LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE lower(p.generic_name) LIKE '%adenosine%' AND lower(p.dosage_form) LIKE '%inject%' ORDER BY p.labeler_name, p.ndc11

Q-9fa1d9.sql: SELECT inspection_id, fei, legal_name, country, end_date, classification, known_date, known_date_basis FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.inspection WHERE fei IN ('3002647489', '3014534') ORDER BY fei, end_date

Q-0b9408.sql: SELECT fei, legal_name, country, action_date, action_type, case_id FROM fda.compliance_actions WHERE fei IN ('3002647489', '3014534') ORDER BY fei, action_date

Q-48ed65.sql: SELECT alert, country, firm, address, date_published, fei, fei_match, firm_key FROM fda.import_alerts WHERE fei IN ('3002647489', '3014534') OR (fei_match <> 'name_and_city' AND firm_key IN ('gland', 'hf acquisition dba healthfirst', 'hf acquisition')) ORDER BY date_published

Q-361f0a.sql: SELECT recall_number, recalling_firm, firm_key, country, classification, status, initiation_date, report_date, substr(reason, 1, 220) AS reason, substr(product_description, 1, 160) AS product_description FROM fda.recalls WHERE firm_key IN ('gland', 'hf acquisition dba healthfirst', 'hf acquisition') AND initiation_date >= '2020-01-01' AND lower(product_description) LIKE '%adenosine%' ORDER BY initiation_date

Q-bab6be.sql: SELECT a.ndc11 AS ndc11, a.generic_name AS item, b.ndc11 AS alt_ndc11, b.generic_name AS alternative, b.strength AS alt_strength, ti.rule, ti.approved_by, ti.approved_on, ti.notes, p.labeler_name AS alt_labeler FROM corvale_general.therapeutic_interchange ti JOIN corvale_general.formulary_item a ON a.item_id = ti.item_id JOIN corvale_general.formulary_item b ON b.item_id = ti.alt_item_id LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = b.ndc11 WHERE a.ndc11 IN ('51662145003', '51662163201', '68083015610')

Q-422ed0.sql: SELECT s.item_key, s.description, s.ndc_as_recorded, s.ndc_match FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_lakeside s LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = s.ndc11 WHERE p.ndc11 IS NULL AND lower(s.description) LIKE '%adenosine%'
